integrity: The counterexample is algebraic and the general obstruction is a direct Riesz-splitting plus intermediate-value proof. Exact rational checks were used only to replay the displayed finite-dimensional witness, not to infer the theorem.
limitations: The exact if-and-only-if classification is proved for finite-dimensional complex normed spaces; in general Banach spaces the theorem classifies the hyperbolic class only.
No claim is made about revisions of arXiv:2610.01196 after the inspected v1.
An equivalent mixed-dichotomy obstruction may exist in older literature under different terminology; targeted searches found none.
title: Mixed hyperbolicity obstructs super asymptotic expansivity
